const $ = sel => document.querySelector(sel);
const $$ = sel => [...document.querySelectorAll(sel)];
function getSetting(key){try{return localStorage.getItem(key)}catch{return null}}
const state={lang:getSetting('femi-lang')==='ar'?'ar':'en',cat:'all',expanded:false,sort:'featured',selected:null,qty:1,custom:false,lastMessage:'',cart:loadCart()};
function loadCart(){try{let parsed=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('femi-inquiry-cart')||'[]');return Array.isArray(parsed)?parsed.filter(v=>typeof v.id==='string' && Number.isInteger(v.qty) && v.qty>0):[]}catch{return []}}
function saveCart(){try{localStorage.setItem('femi-inquiry-cart',JSON.stringify(state.cart))}catch{}updateCartCount()}
function t(key){return i18n[state.lang][key]||key}
function safeText(text){return String(text??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m]))}
function productName(p){return state.lang==='ar'?p.ar:p.en}
function productDesc(p){return state.lang==='ar'?p.arDesc:p.enDesc}
function translatePage(){document.documentElement.lang=state.lang;document.documentElement.dir=state.lang==='ar'?'rtl':'ltr';$('#langSwitch').textContent=state.lang==='ar'?'EN':'عربي';$$('[data-i18n]').forEach(el=>el.textContent=t(el.dataset.i18n));$$('[data-i18n-html]').forEach(el=>el.innerHTML=t(el.dataset.i18nHtml));$$('[data-i18n-placeholder]').forEach(el=>el.setAttribute('placeholder',t(el.dataset.i18nPlaceholder)));$('#menuToggle').setAttribute('aria-label',state.lang==='ar'?'فتح القائمة':'Open menu');renderFilters();renderShop();renderCart();renderSearch();if(state.selected)populateModal();updateCartCount();$('#loadMore').querySelector('span').textContent=state.expanded?t('viewLess'):t('viewMore');prepareTextMotion()}
function renderFilters(){const target=$('#filterList');target.innerHTML=CATEGORIES.map(cat=>`<button class="filter-pill ${cat===state.cat?'active':''}" data-filter="${cat}" aria-pressed="${cat===state.cat}">${safeText(CAT_LABELS[state.lang][cat])}</button>`).join('')}
function getVisibleProducts(){let products=PRODUCTS.filter(p=>state.cat==='all'||p.cat===state.cat);if(state.sort==='az')products.sort((a,b)=>productName(a).localeCompare(productName(b),state.lang));return products}
function renderShop(){const products=getVisibleProducts();const visible=state.expanded?products:products.slice(0,8);$('#productGrid').innerHTML=visible.length?visible.map((p,i)=>`<article class="product-card reveal" style="transition-delay:${Math.min(i%4,3)*60}ms"><button class="product-photo" data-product="${p.id}" aria-label="${safeText(productName(p))}"><img src="${ASSET(p.img)}" loading="lazy" alt="${safeText(productDesc(p))}"/><span class="product-tag">${safeText(p.tag?'FEMI FAVOURITE':t('madeWithLove'))}</span><span class="quick-view">${t('quickView')} ↗</span></button><div class="product-details"><div><p class="product-type">${safeText(CAT_LABELS[state.lang][p.cat])}</p><h3 class="product-name">${safeText(productName(p))}</h3><span class="product-pricing">${t('priceRequest')}</span></div><button class="product-add" data-product="${p.id}" aria-label="${safeText(t('quickView'))}">↗</button></div></article>`).join(''):`<p class="empty-products">${t('empty')}</p>`;$('#loadMore').hidden=products.length<=8;$('#loadMore').querySelector('span').textContent=state.expanded?t('viewLess'):t('viewMore');observeReveals()}
function updateCartCount(){const count=state.cart.reduce((sum,item)=>sum+item.qty,0);$('#cartCount').textContent=count;$('#cartCount').hidden=count===0}
function renderCart(){const target=$('#cartItems');if(!state.cart.length){target.innerHTML=`<div class="cart-empty"><span>✳</span><h3>${t('emptyBasket')}</h3><p>${t('emptyBasketDescription')}</p></div>`;$('#cartRequest').disabled=true;$('#cartRequest').style.opacity='.5';return}$('#cartRequest').disabled=false;$('#cartRequest').style.opacity='1';target.innerHTML=state.cart.map((item,i)=>{const p=PRODUCTS.find(p=>p.id===item.id);if(!p)return '';return `<article class="cart-item"><img src="${ASSET(p.img)}" alt=""/><div><h3>${safeText(productName(p))}</h3><p>${safeText(t('color'))}: ${safeText(item.color)}</p><p>${safeText(t('size'))}: ${safeText(item.size)}</p>${item.notes?`<p>${safeText(item.notes)}</p>`:''}<span class="cart-item-qty">${t('qty')}: ${item.qty}</span></div><button class="remove-item" data-remove="${i}" aria-label="${t('remove')}">×</button></article>`}).join('')}
function renderSearch(query=''){const q=query.trim().toLowerCase();const results=q?PRODUCTS.filter(p=>[p.en,p.ar,p.enDesc,p.arDesc,CAT_LABELS.en[p.cat],CAT_LABELS.ar[p.cat]].some(v=>v.toLowerCase().includes(q))).slice(0,8):PRODUCTS.slice(0,5);$('#searchResults').innerHTML=results.length?results.map(p=>`<button class="search-result" data-product="${p.id}"><img src="${ASSET(p.img)}" alt=""/><span>${safeText(productName(p))}<small style="display:block;margin-top:7px">${safeText(CAT_LABELS[state.lang][p.cat])}</small></span><span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button>`).join(''):`<p class="empty-products">${t('empty')}</p>`}
function openDialog(id){$$('.drawer,.search-modal,.product-modal,.inquiry-modal').forEach(el=>{el.classList.remove('active');el.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true')});$('#overlay').hidden=false;document.body.classList.add('locked');const el=$(id);el.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');requestAnimationFrame(()=>el.classList.add('active'));if(id==='#searchModal')setTimeout(()=>$('#searchInput').focus(),220)}
function closeDialog(){const visible=$$('.drawer.active,.search-modal.active,.product-modal.active,.inquiry-modal.active');visible.forEach(el=>{el.classList.remove('active');el.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true')});$('#overlay').hidden=true;document.body.classList.remove('locked')}
function openProduct(id){const p=PRODUCTS.find(p=>p.id===id);if(!p)return;state.selected=id;state.qty=1;populateModal();$('#productNotes').value='';$('#colorSelect').selectedIndex=0;$('#sizeSelect').selectedIndex=0;openDialog('#productModal')}
function populateModal(){const p=PRODUCTS.find(p=>p.id===state.selected);if(!p)return;$('#modalImage').src=ASSET(p.img);$('#modalImage').alt=productDesc(p);$('#productModalHeading').textContent=productName(p);$('#modalDescription').textContent=productDesc(p);$('#qtyValue').textContent=state.qty;$('#modalThumbs').innerHTML=''}
function addItem(){if(!state.selected)return;const item={id:state.selected,qty:state.qty,color:$('#colorSelect').value,size:$('#sizeSelect').value,notes:$('#productNotes').value.trim().slice(0,400)};const old=state.cart.find(x=>x.id===item.id&&x.color===item.color&&x.size===item.size&&x.notes===item.notes);if(old)old.qty+=item.qty;else state.cart.push(item);saveCart();renderCart();openDialog('#cartDrawer');toast(t('added'))}
function toast(msg){const el=$('#toast');el.textContent=msg;el.classList.add('visible');clearTimeout(toast._id);toast._id=setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('visible'),3400)}
function prepareInquiry(){state.custom=state.custom || state.cart.length===0;$('#inquiryForm').hidden=false;$('#inquirySuccess').hidden=true;openDialog('#inquiryModal')}
function buildMessage(data){let lines=[t('submitIntro'),''];if(state.cart.length && !state.custom){state.cart.forEach((item,i)=>{const p=PRODUCTS.find(p=>p.id===item.id);if(!p)return;lines.push(`${i+1}. ${productName(p)} (${t('qty')}: ${item.qty})`);lines.push(`   ${t('color')}: ${item.color}`);lines.push(`   ${t('size')}: ${item.size}`);if(item.notes)lines.push(`   ${t('notes')}: ${item.notes}`)})}else{lines.push(t('customMessage'))}lines.push('');if(data.name)lines.push(`${t('customer')}: ${data.name}`);if(data.phone)lines.push(`${t('contactNumber')}: ${data.phone}`);if(data.city)lines.push(`${t('city')}: ${data.city}`);if(data.note)lines.push(`${t('otherNotes')}: ${data.note}`);lines.push('',t('pleaseConfirm'));return lines.join('\n')}
async function copyText(text){try{if(navigator.clipboard&&window.isSecureContext){await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);return true}}catch{}try{const fallback=$('#copyFallback');fallback.hidden=false;fallback.value=text;fallback.focus();fallback.select();return document.execCommand('copy')}catch{return false}}
function observeReveals(){const els=$$('.reveal:not(.visible)');if(!('IntersectionObserver'in window)){els.forEach(el=>el.classList.add('visible'));return}if(!observeReveals.observer){observeReveals.observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('visible');observeReveals.observer.unobserve(e.target)}}),{rootMargin:'0px 0px -24px 0px',threshold:.06})}els.forEach(el=>observeReveals.observer.observe(el))}
function saveLanguage(lang){state.lang=lang;try{localStorage.setItem('femi-lang',lang)}catch{}translatePage()}

Object.assign(i18n.en, {
  orbitEyebrow:'THE FEMI ART UNIVERSE', orbitHeading:'Not just pieces.<br><em>Little worlds.</em>', orbitDescription:'An invitation to explore the handmade world from another angle.', orbitHint:'SCROLL TO DISCOVER THE 3D GALLERY', orbitEndEyebrow:'THE COLLECTION REVEALED', orbitEndHeading:'Find the piece<br><em>that feels like you.</em>', orbitFooter:'A NEW PERSPECTIVE ON HANDMADE',
  orbitCard1:'Soft living',orbitCard2:'The little details',orbitCard3:'For little ones',orbitCard4:'Artful walls',orbitCard5:'Wear the story',orbitCard6:'Quiet textures',orbitCard7:'A gift of love',orbitCard8:'Colour your home',
  kineticEyebrow:'A DIFFERENT KIND OF BEAUTY',kineticScroll:'A STORY IN MOTION ↓',kineticLine1:'ONE OF A KIND · ONE OF A KIND ·',kineticLine2:'MADE WITH MEANING · MADE WITH MEANING ·',kineticLine3:'JUST FOR YOU · JUST FOR YOU ·',kineticNote:'Designed with feeling. Made with patience. Kept for years.'
});
Object.assign(i18n.ar, {
  orbitEyebrow:'عالم فيمي آرت',orbitHeading:'مش مجرد قطع<br><em>دي حكايات صغيرة</em>',orbitDescription:'اكتشفي عالم الشغل اليدوي من زاوية مختلفة',orbitHint:'انزلي بالصفحة لاكتشاف الجاليري 3D صورة بصورة',orbitEndEyebrow:'اكتشفي المجموعة',orbitEndHeading:'اختاري قطعة<br><em>تشبه ذوقك</em>',orbitFooter:'زاوية جديدة للفن اليدوي',
  orbitCard1:'دفا البيت',orbitCard2:'تفاصيل صغيرة',orbitCard3:'لأحلى أطفال',orbitCard4:'فن على الحيطان',orbitCard5:'حكاية تلبسيها',orbitCard6:'تفاصيل ناعمة',orbitCard7:'هدية من القلب',orbitCard8:'ألوان تفرّح',
  kineticEyebrow:'جمال مختلف',kineticScroll:'حكاية بتتحرك ↓',kineticLine1:'قطعة مختلفة · قطعة مختلفة ·',kineticLine2:'مصنوعة بمعنى · مصنوعة بمعنى ·',kineticLine3:'مخصوص ليكي · مخصوص ليكي ·',kineticNote:'اتصممت بإحساس واتعملت بصبر علشان تفضل معاكي سنين'
});

/* All text motion uses the EXACT existing Italiana / DM Sans / Cairo font stacks. */
const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
const TYPE_SELECTOR='.hero h1,.section-title,.editorial h2,.custom-inner h2,.contact h2,.orbit-intro h2,.orbit-finale h2';
let typeObserver;
function prepareTextMotion(){
  if(typeObserver)typeObserver.disconnect();
  typeObserver=('IntersectionObserver' in window)?new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
    entries.forEach(entry=>{if(entry.isIntersecting){entry.target.classList.add('type-visible');typeObserver.unobserve(entry.target)}});
  },{threshold:.07,rootMargin:'0px 0px -30px 0px'}):null;
  $$(TYPE_SELECTOR).forEach(el=>{
    // Translate-page resets i18n HTML; this also rebuilds line wrappers on language changes.
    const raw=el.innerHTML.replace(/<span class="type-mask"[^>]*><span class="type-line"[^>]*>/g,'').replace(/<\/span><\/span>/g,'');
    const lines=raw.split(/<br\s*\/?>/i);
    el.innerHTML=lines.map((line,i)=>`<span class="type-mask"><span class="type-line" style="--line-delay:${i*105}ms">${line}</span></span>`).join('');
    el.classList.add('type-motion');el.classList.remove('type-visible');
    if(reduceMotion.matches||!typeObserver){el.classList.add('type-visible');return}
    typeObserver.observe(el);
  });
}

const orbit={cards:[],progress:0,offset:0,velocity:0,drag:false,dragged:false,startX:0,lastX:0,mobileIndex:0,mobileFloat:0,frame:0,mobile:false};
function clamp(n,a,b){return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,n))}
function easeOut(n){return 1-Math.pow(1-clamp(n,0,1),3)}
function interpolate(a,b,t){return a+(b-a)*t}
function updateOrbit(){
  orbit.frame=0;
  const section=$('#orbitGallery'),stage=$('#orbitStage'),deck=$('#orbitDeck');
  if(!section||!stage||!deck)return;
  const mobile=window.matchMedia('(max-width: 860px)').matches;
  orbit.mobile=mobile;
  const n=orbit.cards.length;
  const w=deck.clientWidth,h=deck.clientHeight;
  const cardW=orbit.cards[0]?.offsetWidth||200;
  const cardH=orbit.cards[0]?.offsetHeight||240;
  if(mobile){
    section.style.height=`${Math.max(Math.round(window.innerHeight*(n*.78+1.35)),Math.round(window.innerHeight*4.8))}px`;
    const rect=section.getBoundingClientRect();
    const travel=Math.max(1,section.offsetHeight-window.innerHeight);
    const p=reduceMotion.matches?1:clamp(-rect.top/travel,0,1);
    orbit.progress=p;
    const floatIndex=p*(n-1);
    orbit.mobileFloat=floatIndex;
    orbit.cards.forEach((card,i)=>{
      const d=i-floatIndex;
      const ad=Math.abs(d);
      const x=d*Math.min(w*.58,225);
      const y=Math.min(18,ad*7);
      const z=-ad*135;
      const turn=-Math.sign(d)*Math.min(58,ad*28);
      const scale=Math.max(.60,1-ad*.12);
      card.style.transform=`translate3d(calc(-50% + ${x.toFixed(1)}px),calc(-50% + ${y.toFixed(1)}px),${z.toFixed(1)}px) rotateY(${turn.toFixed(1)}deg) scale(${scale.toFixed(3)})`;
      card.style.opacity=ad>1.8?'0':String(Math.max(0,1-ad*.34));
      card.style.zIndex=String(80-Math.round(ad*10));
      card.style.pointerEvents=ad<.55?'auto':'none';
      card.classList.toggle('orbit-current',ad<.32);
      card.setAttribute('tabindex',ad<.55?'0':'-1');
    });
    const intro=$('#orbitIntro');
    if(intro){
      intro.style.opacity=String(1-easeOut((p-.06)/.18));
      intro.style.transform=`translate3d(-50%,${(-18*easeOut((p-.06)/.18)).toFixed(1)}px,0)`;
    }
    const finale=$('#orbitFinale');
    if(finale)finale.style.opacity='0';
    return;
  }
  section.style.height='';
  const rect=section.getBoundingClientRect();
  const travel=Math.max(1,section.offsetHeight-window.innerHeight);
  const p=reduceMotion.matches?1:clamp(-rect.top/travel,0,1);
  orbit.progress=p;
  const gridT=easeOut((p-.67)/.33);
  const rot=p*Math.PI*2.06+orbit.offset;
  const radiusX=Math.min(w*.34,570),radiusY=Math.min(h*.28,250);
  const gridCols=w<1060?4:4;
  const gapX=clamp((w-160)/gridCols,145,245);
  const gapY=clamp(h*.35,252,305);
  orbit.cards.forEach((card,i)=>{
    const a=i/n*Math.PI*2+rot+Math.PI*.11;
    const front=Math.sin(a);
    const ox=Math.cos(a)*radiusX;
    const oy=Math.sin(a)*radiusY;
    const oz=front*220;
    const ix=i%gridCols,iy=Math.floor(i/gridCols);
    const gx=(ix-(gridCols-1)/2)*gapX;
    const gy=(iy-.5)*gapY + 65;
    const x=interpolate(ox,gx,gridT);
    const y=interpolate(oy,gy,gridT);
    const z=interpolate(oz,0,gridT);
    const ry=interpolate(-Math.cos(a)*23,0,gridT);
    const rx=interpolate(Math.sin(a)*11,0,gridT);
    const scale=interpolate(.86+(front+1)*.13,Math.min(1.02,gapX/cardW*.96),gridT);
    card.style.transform=`translate3d(calc(-50% + ${x.toFixed(2)}px),calc(-50% + ${y.toFixed(2)}px),${z.toFixed(2)}px) rotateY(${ry.toFixed(2)}deg) rotateX(${rx.toFixed(2)}deg) scale(${scale.toFixed(3)})`;
    card.style.opacity=String(interpolate(.68+(front+1)*.13,1,gridT));
    card.style.zIndex=String(gridT>.85?10+i:Math.round(20+oz/12));
    card.style.pointerEvents=(front<-.7&&gridT<.3)?'none':'auto';
    card.setAttribute('tabindex',front<-.7&&gridT<.3?'-1':'0');
  });
  $('#orbitIntro').style.opacity=String(1-easeOut((p-.57)/.20));
  $('#orbitIntro').style.transform=`translate3d(0,${(-48*easeOut((p-.56)/.21)).toFixed(1)}px,0)`;
  $('#orbitFinale').style.opacity=String(easeOut((p-.70)/.16));
  $('#orbitFinale').style.transform=`translateX(-50%) translateY(${(20*(1-easeOut((p-.70)/.16))).toFixed(1)}px)`;
  const bar=$('#orbitProgressFill');if(bar)bar.style.transform=`scaleX(${p})`;
  const percentEl=$('#orbitPercent');if(percentEl)percentEl.textContent=String(Math.round(p*100)).padStart(2,'0')+'%';
  $('#orbitStage').classList.toggle('orbit-grid-finished',p>.92);
}
function scheduleOrbit(){if(!orbit.frame)orbit.frame=requestAnimationFrame(updateOrbit)}
function moveOrbitMobile(delta){orbit.mobileIndex=(orbit.mobileIndex+delta+orbit.cards.length)%orbit.cards.length;scheduleOrbit()}
function initOrbit(){
  const deck=$('#orbitDeck');if(!deck)return;
  orbit.cards=$$('[data-orbit-product]');
  deck.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
    if(e.button!==0||orbit.mobile)return;
    orbit.drag=true;orbit.dragged=false;orbit.startX=e.clientX;orbit.lastX=e.clientX;
    try{(e.target.closest('[data-orbit-product]')||deck).setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch{}
  });
  deck.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
    if(!orbit.drag)return;
    const dx=e.clientX-orbit.lastX;
    orbit.lastX=e.clientX;
    if(Math.abs(e.clientX-orbit.startX)>9)orbit.dragged=true;
    if(!orbit.mobile){orbit.offset+=dx*.0057;scheduleOrbit()}
  });
  const endDrag=e=>{
    if(!orbit.drag)return;
    orbit.drag=false;
    const dx=e.clientX-orbit.startX;
    if(orbit.mobile&&Math.abs(dx)>42)moveOrbitMobile(dx<0?1:-1);
    if(orbit.dragged){deck.dataset.justDragged='1';setTimeout(()=>delete deck.dataset.justDragged,180)}
  };
  deck.addEventListener('pointerup',endDrag);deck.addEventListener('pointercancel',endDrag);
  deck.addEventListener('click',e=>{
    if(deck.dataset.justDragged){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();return}
    const card=e.target.closest('[data-orbit-product]');
    if(!card)return;
    openProduct(card.dataset.orbitProduct);
  },true);
  const orbitPrev=$('#orbitPrev'); if(orbitPrev) orbitPrev.addEventListener('click',()=>moveOrbitMobile(-1));
  const orbitNext=$('#orbitNext'); if(orbitNext) orbitNext.addEventListener('click',()=>moveOrbitMobile(1));
  deck.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!orbit.mobile)return;if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'||e.key==='ArrowRight'){e.preventDefault();moveOrbitMobile(e.key==='ArrowRight'?1:-1)}});
  window.addEventListener('scroll',scheduleOrbit,{passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('resize',scheduleOrbit,{passive:true});
  reduceMotion.addEventListener('change',()=>{prepareTextMotion();scheduleOrbit()});
  scheduleOrbit();
}
function initKinetic(){
  const section=$('#kineticSection');if(!section)return;
  let frame=0;
  const render=()=>{
    frame=0;
    if(reduceMotion.matches)return;
    const rect=section.getBoundingClientRect();
    if(rect.bottom<0||rect.top>window.innerHeight)return;
    const p=clamp((window.innerHeight-rect.top)/(window.innerHeight+rect.height),0,1);
    $$('.kinetic-line').forEach((el,i)=>{
      const sign=i%2===0?1:-1;
      el.style.transform=`translate3d(${(sign*(.5-p)*Math.min(window.innerWidth*.31,330)).toFixed(1)}px,0,0)`;
    });
  };
  const req=()=>{if(!frame)frame=requestAnimationFrame(render)};
  window.addEventListener('scroll',req,{passive:true});window.addEventListener('resize',req,{passive:true});render();
}
function init(){
 $('#copyrightYear').textContent=new Date().getFullYear();
 // Arabic is the default for Egyptian browser locales, otherwise English.
 if(!getSetting('femi-lang') && (navigator.language||'').toLowerCase().startsWith('ar'))state.lang='ar';
 translatePage();observeReveals();initOrbit();initKinetic();
 $('#langSwitch').addEventListener('click',()=>saveLanguage(state.lang==='ar'?'en':'ar'));
 $('#menuToggle').addEventListener('click',()=>{const el=$('#mobileMenu'),willOpen=el.hidden;el.hidden=!willOpen;$('#menuToggle').setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(willOpen))});
 $$('#mobileMenu a').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',()=>{$('#mobileMenu').hidden=true;$('#menuToggle').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false')}));
 $$('#categoryGrid .category-card').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.cat=btn.dataset.category;state.expanded=true;renderFilters();renderShop();$('#featured').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})}));
 $('#filterList').addEventListener('click',e=>{const btn=e.target.closest('[data-filter]');if(!btn)return;state.cat=btn.dataset.filter;state.expanded=false;renderFilters();renderShop()});
 $('#sortSelect').addEventListener('change',e=>{state.sort=e.target.value;renderShop()});
 $('#loadMore').addEventListener('click',()=>{state.expanded=!state.expanded;renderShop();if(!state.expanded)$('#featured').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})});
 $('#productGrid').addEventListener('click',e=>{const btn=e.target.closest('[data-product]');if(btn)openProduct(btn.dataset.product)});
 $('#cartOpen').addEventListener('click',()=>{renderCart();openDialog('#cartDrawer')});
 $('#searchOpen').addEventListener('click',()=>{renderSearch();$('#searchInput').value='';openDialog('#searchModal')});
 $('#searchInput').addEventListener('input',e=>renderSearch(e.target.value));
 $('#searchResults').addEventListener('click',e=>{const btn=e.target.closest('[data-product]');if(btn)openProduct(btn.dataset.product)});
 $('#qtyMinus').addEventListener('click',()=>{$('#qtyValue').textContent=state.qty=Math.max(1,state.qty-1)});
 $('#qtyPlus').addEventListener('click',()=>{$('#qtyValue').textContent=state.qty=Math.min(99,state.qty+1)});
 $('#addToBasket').addEventListener('click',addItem);
 $('#cartItems').addEventListener('click',e=>{const btn=e.target.closest('[data-remove]');if(!btn)return;state.cart.splice(Number(btn.dataset.remove),1);saveCart();renderCart()});
 $('#cartRequest').addEventListener('click',()=>{state.custom=false;prepareInquiry()});
 $('#customOpen').addEventListener('click',()=>{state.custom=true;prepareInquiry()});
 $('#overlay').addEventListener('click',closeDialog);
 $$('[data-close]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',closeDialog));
 document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeDialog()});
 $('#inquiryForm').addEventListener('submit',async e=>{e.preventDefault();const data=Object.fromEntries(new FormData(e.currentTarget).entries());state.lastMessage=buildMessage(data);const copied=await copyText(state.lastMessage);$('#inquiryForm').hidden=true;$('#inquirySuccess').hidden=false;$('#copyFallback').value=state.lastMessage;$('#copyFallback').hidden=copied;toast(t(copied?'copied':'copyManual'))});
 $('#copyAgain').addEventListener('click',async()=>{const result=await copyText(state.lastMessage);$('#copyFallback').hidden=result;toast(t(result?'copied':'copyManual'))});
 const updateProgress=()=>{const max=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight;document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--progress',`${max>0?Math.min(100,window.scrollY/max*100):0}%`);$('#siteHeader').classList.toggle('scrolled',window.scrollY>20)};document.addEventListener('scroll',updateProgress,{passive:true});updateProgress();
}
init();

</script>
</body>
